brands.evidence: Pick Monzo if: Budgeting matters most to you. Monzo is the pick for the best budgeting tools
Pick Starling if: You want everything free without upsells.

client_claims.text: On a free account, Monzo gives £200 a month of free foreign ATM withdrawals and charges 3% after that.
client_claims.note: Matches the £200 allowance outside the EEA and 3% fee; the answer omits the 30-day period and the EEA detail.

client_claims.text: Neither charges fees on foreign card spending.
client_claims.note: Monzo charges no fee on card spending abroad.

client_claims.text: Both are FSCS protected up to £120,000.
Monzo charges 19–39% EAR on arranged overdrafts, depending on your credit score.
Monzo can match or beat Starling's savings rate only on its paid Perks or Max plans.
client_claims.note: Facts give only the free plan rate of 2.80% AER, not paid plan rates.

client_claims.text: Monzo offers personal loans and the Monzo Flex credit card as well as an overdraft.
Monzo came first for business service quality in the August 2026 results.
Monzo has bill splitting, instant Monzo-to-Monzo payments and connected accounts.
Monzo doesn't offer accounting integrations and an overdraft in its business free tier.
